Third-party component: Fabric API
Upstream: https://github.com/FabricMC/fabric-api

License copy: third_party/FABRIC_API_LICENSE.txt

MKM distributes the unmodified upstream Fabric API distribution as a nested
mod via Fabric Loom include(). No Fabric API Java classes have been copied into
MKM's own packages. Fabric Loader loads the official nested distribution and its
individual API modules in accordance with its standard mod dependency system.
